text: The rite of the removal from the cross was performed at the Holy Trinity Cathedral.
The traditional rite of the Burial of Christ was performed at the Holy Trinity Cathedral. The service symbolically depicts the burial and lamentation of Jesus Christ crucified on the cross.
The rite was performed today by the locum tenens of the Patriarchal Throne, Metropolitan Shio of Senaki and Chkhorotsku (Mujiri), together with the bishops.
Today is Good Friday, the most solemn day of Holy Week. The Orthodox Church commemorates the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, His descent from the Cross, and His burial.

On Good Friday, no liturgy is celebrated in churches, because, according to the Gospel, the Lord offered Himself as a sacrifice to redeem humanity from sin. During the service, the Royal Hours are performed, during which the Gospel about the Lord’s Passion is read.
Believers dye eggs red on this day and also bake paskas, because, according to the Gospel, the crucifixion of Jesus Christ took place on the Jewish Passover holiday.
